changes.name: RemoveWestExpansionLandV40
changes.source:
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")

-- Remove any expansion land extending left/west of the starter island.
-- Starter island west edge is approximately X = -27.
local function removeLeftChunks(container)
 for _,obj in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
  if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name~="StarterIsland" and obj.Name~="IslandEarth" then
   local isExpansion = obj.Name:match("^L%d+_") or obj.Name:find("Expansion")
   if isExpansion then
    local leftEdge=obj.Position.X-(obj.Size.X/2)
    if leftEdge < -27.5 then
     obj:Destroy()
    end
   end
  end
 end
end

local function clean()
 local directional=world:FindFirstChild("DirectionalExpansions")
 if directional then removeLeftChunks(directional) end

 -- Also remove legacy expansion land on the left side from older builds.
 for _,obj in ipairs(world:GetChildren()) do
  if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name~="StarterIsland" and obj.Name~="IslandEarth" then
   if obj.Name:find("Expansion") and obj.Position.X < -27 then
    obj:Destroy()
   end
  end
 end
end

clean()
world.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
 task.wait()
 if obj:IsA("BasePart") then clean() end
end)

print("West-side expansion land removed")
